newsitems.title: v1.5.18 - The Minor Fixes Update!
newsitems.author: Deltars
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39353128/98e5525667667f93645fbf12d60efb4bb6c1d0e3.png[/img]

Dear Players,

In this minor update, we are going through a long list of minor fixes and improvements. While there are no new features or major headlines, this is a necessary and valuable improvement to the quality of experience when playing CC2.

These updates touch many different areas of the game in subtle and different ways. Please see the patch notes below for more info on exactly what has changed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39353128/85c58ecaf8b53e161d6feb7261f7f03250475f2f.png[/img]

We hope you enjoy these new updates!

Much love <3,

The Carrier Command Developers

v1.5.18

Fixes
Updated Steam SDK
VR orientation recenter now only updates yaw
Fixed enemy AI sometimes failing to aim at predicted target positions
Fixed enemy carrier aggression incorrectly evaluating captured territory
Fixed enemy carriers not entering the island capture state
Fixed vertical mouse sensitivity and inversion settings being ignored
Fixed flight mouse sensitivity ignoring the vertical axis value
Fixed torpedo explosions using the decoy damage value
Fixed vehicle wheel suspension compression not clamping correctly
Fixed explosion damage falloff calculation
Fixed cursor interaction on vehicle screens in the menu
Fixed weapon attachment selection going out of range
Fixed carrier battle music not triggering correctly
Fixed intro cryo sequence door and mask animations
Fixed island and terrain generation errors
Fixed missile tracking using an incorrect object id
Fixed character pathfinding bounds calculation
Fixed server lobby screen flickering on macOS
Fixed in-game support links

newsitems.title: v1.5.14 - The PvP Rebalance Update!
newsitems.author: Deltars
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39353128/98e5525667667f93645fbf12d60efb4bb6c1d0e3.png[/img]

Dear Players,

Today we have released a minor update with many updates related to PvP balance. We are adding "low light" mode to vehicles to help avoid detection when playing PvP, as well as reducing the max speed of planes carrying payloads, allowed countermeasures against bombs, etc.

Some new aspects are also now moddable, including IR flares, 160mm artillery, and smoke launchers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39353128/85c58ecaf8b53e161d6feb7261f7f03250475f2f.png[/img]

We hope you enjoy these new updates!

Much love <3,

The Carrier Command Developers

v1.5.14

Feature - added low light mode for disabling lights on vehicles
Feature - max thrust reduced when carrying some large payloads for manta and albatross
Rework - added larger ammo storage for needlefish ship
Rework - added moddable value for 160mm salvo size
Rework - CIWS now fires at bombs
Rework - increased hit radius for aircraft dogfighting
Rework - aerial refueling now uses hold-fire toggle rather than stablization setting
Rework - attacker team id data included in server logging
Rework - IR flare cooldown time is now moddable
Rework - smoke launchers added to default loadout
Rework - smoke stream now togglable rather than fire and forget
Rework - smoke launchers are now moddable
Fix - updated French translation for helm
Fix - fixed issue with MacOS builds sometimes not uploading correctly

newsitems.title: v1.5.13 - The Server Telemetry Update!
newsitems.author: Deltars
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39353128/98e5525667667f93645fbf12d60efb4bb6c1d0e3.png[/img]

Dear Players,

Today we have released a minor update including telemetry logging output for server events. This has been requested by players who run servers who are interested in post-game analysis as well as real-time monitoring of their online servers.

When hosting a game, a log file (named with the time when the game was started) will be created. The file will be populated with event data in jsonl format in real time.

We also have some minor changes and fixes to the previous update. See the notes below for details.

We have many more changes planned, largely with a focus on balance. Moving forward, many of our changes will be controllable via the constant values feature so that they are mod-able.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39353128/85c58ecaf8b53e161d6feb7261f7f03250475f2f.png[/img]

Much love <3,

The Carrier Command Developers

v1.5.13

Feature - Added background logging to server for chat, join, leave, vehicle destroy events
Rework - Only air vehicles can receive fuel from fuel tank attachment
Rework - Display fuel tank as empty slot on HUD when fuel tank dropped
Fix - Fix for 4 shield islands not spawning
Fix - Fixed tabs in localization file
